name: alterlab-rowan
description: Builds and validates Rowan computational-chemistry jobs with the rowan-python API and previews the chemistry locally with no account — constructs 3D molecules and job payloads (pKa, geometry optimization, conformers, docking, AI cofolding), validates every submission's arguments offline, and runs a local RDKit/xTB preview (MMFF/GFN2-xTB geometry and conformer energies) so you see a first answer before spending credits. Submitting the job to Rowan's cloud runs on their servers, consumes credits,
author: AlterLab-IEU
